name: Smilin' Biden
look: A photo of Joe Biden in a dark suit, white shirt and tie with a small flag pin, grinning widely with his mouth open and pointing straight at the viewer against a dark background.
use: A cheerful, cheeky call-out. The grinning point singles out the viewer, so captions are playful compliments, teasing accusations or I-see-what-you-did-there moments, delivered like an enthusiastic uncle.
examples: Saw you take the last donut
